rows.question: 销售部的编制空缺率是多少？

rows.question: 质量部的编制空缺率是多少？

rows.question: 各部门的编制总数和在职人数分别是多少？只列出空缺率超过 10% 的部门。
rows.sql: SELECT d.dept_name, d.headcount_budget AS 编制总数, COUNT(e.emp_id) AS 在职人数, (d.headcount_budget - COUNT(e.emp_id)) * 1.0 / d.headcount_budget AS 空缺率 FROM departments d LEFT JOIN employees e ON d.dept_id = e.dept_id AND e.status = '在职' GROUP BY d.dept_id, d.dept_name, d.headcount_budget HAVING (d.headcount_budget - COUNT(e.emp_id)) * 1.0 / d.headcount_budget > 0.1

rows.question: 哪些部门 2026 年上半年的离职率超过了 5%？列出部门名和离职率。
rows.sql: SELECT d.dept_name, ROUND(1.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN e.leave_date IS NOT NULL AND e.leave_date BETWEEN '2026-01-01' AND '2026-06-30' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / SUM(CASE WHEN e.hire_date < '2026-01-01' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 4) AS turnover_rate FROM employees e JOIN departments d ON e.dept_id = d.dept_id GROUP BY d.dept_id, d.dept_name HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN e.hire_date < '2026-01-01' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 AND 1.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN e.leave_date IS NOT NULL AND e.leave_date BETWEEN '2026-01-01' AND '2026-06-30' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / SUM(CASE WHEN e.hire_date < '2026-01-01' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0.05
